title: Die Chronyk van Hollandt, Zeelandt ende Vriesland (Divisiekroniek) of Cornelius Aurelius, 1517
author: Cornelius Aurelius
institution: Huygens Institute (transcribed by A. de Hamer, 2011)
notes: Reader with page images and a transcription of the 1517 Leiden edition (Jan Seversz; copy in the Koninklijke Bibliotheek, The Hague), a history of Holland, Zeeland and Friesland from earliest times to 1517.
